subject: QuantLeaf: Discovery recap, stakeholder gates & proposed commitments
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@quantleaf.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: QuantLeaf: Discovery recap, stakeholder gates & proposed commitments

Hi Alyssa,

Thanks again for the 45-minute sync today — appreciated the candid breakdown of where QuantLeaf needs to tighten reliability while bringing inference costs down. Below is a concise recap plus a proposal for a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we have aligned owners and dates. I copied Ben and Rishi to loop in pricing and technical validation owners.

Key pain points you shared
- Latency spikes at inference tail (95-99th percentile) on long sequences, affecting real-time UI and causing client complaints.
- Multi-region data residency requirement for EU customers; current vendor tooling adds 60–120ms network overhead.
- Cost pressure: need to reduce per-1M-token bill by ~30% without degrading model quality.
- Procurement needs: SOC 2 evidence, KMS integration details, and sample contract redlines.

Primary goals (QuantLeaf)
1) Pilot demonstrating 50ms median / <250ms p95 for 2k token median sequences in our US region.
2) Proof of region-isolated inference for EU cohort (data residency) with encryption at rest.
3) Achieve 30% unit-cost improvement via batching + KV caching + 8-bit quantization in POC.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level)
- Milestone 1 — Technical kickoff & environment access: QuantLeaf provides sample payloads, expected traffic profiles, and a small test dataset. Owner: Alyssa / James. Target date: 2026-11-15.
- Milestone 2 — POC environment + benchmarks: Redwood spins up Dedicated pilot capacity (US) and runs baseline + optimized runs (quantization + caching). Owner: Soojin / Ben. Target date: 2026-12-08.
- Milestone 3 — Security & procurement review: Share SOC2 artifacts, KMS integration plan; legal to review term sheet. Owner: James (QuantLeaf) / Rishi (Redwood). Target date: 2026-12-01 (procurement kickoff) and contract redlines by 2026-12-05.
- Milestone 4 — EU region proof & go/no-go: Run region-isolated POC for EU customers. Owner: Alyssa / Soojin. Target date: 2026-12-22.
- Decision gate: QuantLeaf to confirm pilot success and sign for Dedicated commit or opt for Hosted with SLA adjustments. Decision target: 2027-01-05.

Quick asks from our side (to keep momentum)
- Can you send the three sample payloads we discussed and an estimated qps/seq-length distribution by 11/12?
- Please share procurement contact (if different from James) and any mandatory security checklist items beyond SOC2.

Attachments I’m including now: Redwood pricing sheet (baseline vs optimized), MPA draft and the SOC2 requirements summary (we flagged the items Procurement will typically ask for).

If that matches your read, I’ll convert this into a one-page MAP doc and Ben will include an indicative pilot pricing and credit structure.

Thanks — Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com | +1-415-555-0123
From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@quantleaf.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: James O'Neill <james.oneill@quantleaf.com>, QuantLeaf Sales <sales@quantleaf.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: QuantLeaf: Discovery recap, stakeholder gates & proposed commitments

Thanks Soojin — this is a great summary and aligns with our internal notes. A few clarifications / confirmations from our side: 

- Sample payloads: I’ll upload three representative payload files (short, medium, long) and a traffic histogram to the shared Drive by EOD 11/11.
- Procurement: James is coordinating; procurement checklist items include: SOC2 Type II, IP indemnity language around model outputs (we'll share the exact clause), and an obligation for data segregation for EU data.
- Decision process: Our procurement + security review will provide an initial verdict by 12/05; final exec signoff on budget will be on the week of 01/04.

We’re happy to proceed with your proposed dates. Please include a line-item for pilot credits and a two-week rollback clause in the MPA draft (standard for us).

Attachments: none on my end right now — will upload payloads to the drive link you provided.

Cheers,
Alyssa

--
Alyssa Turner
Head of Product Engineering | QuantLeaf
alyssa.turner@quantleaf.com | +1-212-555-0987
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@quantleaf.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: QuantLeaf: Discovery recap, stakeholder gates & proposed commitments

Alyssa, Soojin — thanks for the clear plan. I attached an editable MAP draft and the pricing sheet showing baseline vs optimized POC numbers. Highlights:
- We can provide a pilot credit of up to $25k to cover 4 weeks of Dedicated capacity for the POC if QuantLeaf signs the MAP with the standard pilot terms (two-week rollback included).
- Preliminary estimate shows ~28–35% unit cost reduction using batching + 8-bit quantization plus prefix KV caching; final numbers will depend on sequence-length distribution you provide.
- Rishi will share the SOC2 package and a KMS integration checklist by 11/10.

Next steps I’ll own:
1) Soojin & team to run baseline tests once payloads are uploaded (target 11/16).
2) Redwood to deliver optimized benchmark and tuning recommendations (target 12/08).
3) Legal to exchange a one-page term sheet and pilot SOW (target 11/25).

I’ve attached: QL_MPA_draft.docx (editable), redwood-pricing-sheet.pdf, and a short pilot SOW template.

Happy to jump on a brief call early next week if you want to walk through the MAP draft.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1-650-555-2244

Subject: Re: QuantLeaf: Discovery recap, stakeholder gates & proposed commitments

Appreciate it Ben — the credit structure sounds reasonable and the two-week rollback is fine. I’ll confirm by 11/12 once we upload the payloads.

James — looping you to confirm procurement start and to request any preferred contract templates.

Talk soon,
Alyssa
